WWE Releases: This Release Wave Is Bigger Than It Looks — And They're All Connected

thread // May 3, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Read more on Threads

I feel like people aren't talking about this enough. It's not just who got released. It's how many of them were connected.

This wave feels bigger than it looks.

Who's gone

On May 2, four names left WWE at once:

  • Kofi Kingston
  • Xavier Woods
  • Tonga Loa
  • JC Mateo

Now look at them as pairs.

The New Day, both at once

Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods are two-thirds of The New Day, one of the most decorated tag teams in WWE history, and they left together. According to reports, they were asked to restructure their contracts under TKO, WWE's parent company, didn't like the offers, and the two sides agreed to part ways. After nearly 16 years for Woods, and longer for Kofi, they walked out the same door on the same day.

That's not a normal release. That's a whole era of WWE ending in one afternoon.

Two members of MFT

Tonga Loa and JC Mateo were both part of Solo Sikoa's group, MFT, alongside Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga on SmackDown. Losing two members of the same faction on the same day guts that storyline, and it says a lot about where that group stood.

Why it's bigger than it looks

Releases usually hit random names from different corners of the roster. This one took out whole units: a legendary tag team and half of an active faction. And it came in a year when WWE has already let go of dozens of wrestlers, including former world champions like Sheamus.

When the cuts start hitting connected groups instead of individuals, that tells you the company is reshaping entire parts of the show, not just trimming the roster.

Update (September 2026)

The New Day didn't stay gone for long. After their 90-day non-competes ran out, Kofi and Xavier Woods, now going by his real name, Austin Creed, showed up at AEW All In: London at the end of August. They were the surprise team in the Trios match, teamed up with Swerve Strickland, and won the AEW World Trios Championship in their very first match. Their new trio is called The New Level.

JC Mateo teased a return to New Japan a couple of weeks after his release, but he hasn't confirmed his next stop.

Sources: CBS Sports, POST Wrestling, Slam Wrestling, Ringside News

Quick answers

Why did Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods leave WWE? According to reports, they were asked to restructure their contracts under TKO, didn't accept the offers, and mutually agreed to leave in May 2026.

Where did Kofi Kingston and Xavier Woods go after WWE? To AEW. They debuted at All In: London in August 2026 and won the AEW World Trios Championship with Swerve Strickland.

Who else was released in May 2026? Tonga Loa and JC Mateo, both members of Solo Sikoa's MFT group.

What is Xavier Woods called in AEW? Austin Creed, his real name.
